summary.finalText:
Created `hidden/`, `run-hidden.mjs`, `rubric.md`, `VALIDATION.md`, and `MANIFEST.json`. References and evidence are in `scratch/`.

**33 counted tests:** T-ORDER 4, T-LOTS 2, T-IDEM 6, T-RACE 4, T-REVERSAL 4, T-AUTH 3, T-PENDING 2, T-CLOCK 2, T-FAIL 3, T-EFF 3.

Validation:
- Base/import-broken: **0/33**, no runner crashes.
- Correct reference: **33/33**, five consecutive runs.
- Naive reference: **16/33**, all basic required traps pass.
- Seven isolated variants: only targeted tests fail.

`base/` and `v1/` unchanged. Manifest written last.
bashCommands: pwd && ls -la && find v1 base -type f | sort
mkdir -p hidden scratch && cp v1/hidden/acceptance.test.ts hidden/acceptance.test.ts && cp v1/run-hidden.mjs run-hidden.mjs && cp v1/rubric.md rubric.md && node --version
node scratch/catalog.mjs && node run-hidden.mjs base scratch/validation/base
mkdir -p scratch/correct && cp -R base/. scratch/correct/ && chmod -R u+w scratch/correct
for v in naive race replay failure reversal eff; do mkdir -p scratch/$v; cp -R scratch/correct/. scratch/$v/; done
for v in naive race replay failure reversal eff; do echo "$v"; node run-hidden.mjs scratch/$v scratch/validation/$v; done

mkdir -p scratch/broken && cp -R base/. scratch/broken/ && chmod -R u+w scratch/broken && mkdir -p scratch/correct/evaluator-hidden && cp hidden/store-counter.ts scratch/correct/evaluator-hidden/store-counter.ts

node scratch/counter-selftest.ts && node run-hidden.mjs base scratch/validation/base && node run-hidden.mjs scratch/broken scratch/validation/broken && for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do echo "correct-$i"; node run-hidden.mjs scratch/correct scratch/validation/correct-$i; done && for v in naive race replay failure reversal eff; do echo "$v"; node run-hidden.mjs scratch/$v scratch/validation/$v; done
for v in replay-ownership replay-recompute; do mkdir -p scratch/$v; cp -R scratch/correct/. scratch/$v/; done; cp hidden/store-counter.ts scratch/correct/evaluator-hidden/store-counter.ts

node scratch/counter-selftest.ts && node scratch/validate.mjs && mkdir -p scratch/direct && cp -R scratch/correct/. scratch/direct/ && rm -rf scratch/direct/evaluator-hidden && cp -R hidden scratch/direct/evaluator-hidden && (cd scratch/direct && node --test "evaluator-hidden/*.test.ts") > scratch/validation/direct.log 2>&1 && (cd scratch/correct && node --test "tests/**/*.test.ts") > scratch/validation/public.log 2>&1
wc -l hidden/*.ts run-hidden.mjs rubric.md scratch/validation/public.log scratch/validation/direct.log && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort && du -sh scratch

node scratch/validate.mjs && cp hidden/store-counter.ts scratch/correct/evaluator-hidden/store-counter.ts && node scratch/counter-selftest.ts && rm -rf scratch/direct/evaluator-hidden && cp -R hidden scratch/direct/evaluator-hidden && (cd scratch/direct && node --test "evaluator-hidden/*.test.ts") > scratch/validation/direct.log 2>&1

find . -path './scratch' -prune -o -path './base' -prune -o -path './v1' -prune -o -type f -print | sort && shasum -a 256 hidden/acceptance.test.ts hidden/cases.json hidden/store-counter.ts run-hidden.mjs rubric.md VALIDATION.md
